senses.gloss:
bhayá, n.
 —1. fear, anxiety; in composition
w. the thing feared, 10^12, 31^9, 46^5;
fear of a thing (abl.), 40^14; bhayāt, from
fear, 20^10, 36^4, 41^17; then, as conversely
in Eng., fear (orig. ‘danger,’ so Job 39. 22)
has come to mean ‘anxiety,’
 —2. danger,
peril, 25^19, 423, 4. [√bhī, 1148. 1a: for
mg 2, cf. saṃdeha.]
